cards.name: Swarm of Scarabs
cards.officialText: Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. If this card is Flip Summoned: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.
cards.historicalEligibility: Both OCG and TCG printings precede the cutoff

cards.name: Swarm of Locusts
cards.officialText: Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. If this card is Flip Summoned: Target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy that target.
cards.historicalEligibility: Both OCG and TCG printings precede the cutoff

twoVTwoAdaptation.fieldZone: separate one-slot Field Zone per team; targetable by Swarm of Locusts, never treated as a normal Spell/Trap zone slot
twoVTwoAdaptation.flipSummon: the destruction trigger occurs only after a true Flip Summon, not when another effect merely turns the card face-up
twoVTwoAdaptation.scarabs: targets exactly one monster controlled by the opposing team at activation
twoVTwoAdaptation.locusts: targets exactly one Spell/Trap or Field Zone card controlled by the opposing team at activation
twoVTwoAdaptation.targetResolution: a target that leaves the field before resolution is not destroyed; face-down targets are selected by slot without revealing identity
twoVTwoAdaptation.ownership: destroyed cards enter the shared Graveyard of the team belonging to the physical owner seat, not the current controller team
twoVTwoAdaptation.selfSet: separate ignition effect, usable in either Main Phase of the controller team's turn once per physical UID per turn; caller persists the usage ledger A successfully resolved activation consumes that physical copy's once-per-turn usage even if the source left the field or is no longer face-up when the Chain resolves; an activation negated before resolution is handled by the caller's chain ledger.
twoVTwoAdaptation.privacy: face-down target options hide card IDs and physical UIDs; destroyed cards become public in the Graveyard
twoVTwoAdaptation.sourceDeparture: Flip Summon destruction trigger can resolve if the source is removed after the Flip Summon trigger is generated

limits: Pure helpers return instructions and do not mutate field, Spell/Trap, Field Zone, or Graveyard state.
Self-set once-per-turn usage must be persisted by the runtime keyed to the physical card UID; not yet integrated.
Actual card certification requires registration in the shared resolver and live 2v2/Discord integration tests.
